// ------------------------------------------------------------
// XCOM: Enemy Within ultrawide UI and camera fixes (EU)
//
// NB: This mod is specifically designed to work with the Enemy Unknown (EU) version of XCOM.
//
// - Main fixes:
//   - Fix screen-to-UI and UI-to-screen coordinate mapping
//   - Correct FOV to be Hor+ in both tactical and strategic screens
// - UI tweaks:
//   - Center modal dialogue box on ultrawide resolutions
//   - Stretch Headquarters top menu bar to full width on ultrawide resolutions
//   - Fix initial position top menu bar
//   - Prevent Build Facility hologram stretching
// - Retains support for sub-16:9 aspect ratios.
// - Includes special uninstall handling to allow uninstall scripts to be properly generated.
// - Tested with Steam EU.
//
// Install using PatcherGUI: https://www.nexusmods.com/xcom/mods/448
//
// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Changelog 3.2.0:
// - Fix placement of damage UI popups when more than one popup is visible
//
// Changelog 3.1.0:
// - Prevent Build Facility hologram stretching
//
// Changelog 3.0.0:
// - Rewrote executable patcher code into PatchUPK patch file
// - Reinstated original sub-16:9 aspect ratio support
//
// Changelog 2.0.0:
// - Rewrote executable patcher into C++
// - Added UI aesthetic tweaks
//
// Changelog 1.1.0:
// - Initial release
// ------------------------------------------------------------

MOD_NAME = Ultrawide UI and camera fixes (EU)
DESCRIPTION = Ultrawide UI and camera fixes to turn XCOM-EU into a Hor+ game. Tested on Steam EU.
AUTHOR = Sparq


// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Fix screen-to-UI and UI-to-screen coordinate mapping
//
// Replace:
//   UIFxsMovie.ConvertNormalizedUICoordsToScreenCoords (UI-to-screen)
//   XComInputBase.ConvertUIPointToScreenCoordinate (bad name, does screen-to-UI)
//   UIWorldMessageMgr.UpdateMessages (Was missing call to UI-to-screen conversion for multi-message update)
//
// Map between screen pixels and the game's 1280x720 UI canvas using
// the smaller width/height scale and centering on both axes:
//
//     Scale = Min(ScreenWidth / 1280.0, ScreenHeight / 720.0)
//     OffsetX = (ScreenWidth - 1280.0 * Scale) * 0.5
//     OffsetY = (ScreenHeight - 720.0 * Scale) * 0.5
//
//     Screen to UI (after converting normalized coordinates to pixels):
//         UIX = (ScreenX - OffsetX) / Scale
//         UIY = (ScreenY - OffsetY) / Scale
//
//     UI to screen:
//         ScreenX = UIX * Scale + OffsetX
//         ScreenY = UIY * Scale + OffsetY
//
// This keeps both conversions consistent, prevents horizontal stretching,
// and preserves 16:9 behavior.
// ------------------------------------------------------------

UPK_FILE = XComGame.upk

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// PHASE 1 - Add entries (don't uninstall them)
// ------------------------------------------------------------

UNINSTALL = FALSE

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Center modal dialogue box on ultrawide resolutions.
//
// The DialogueBox.realise actionscript function does:
//
//  this.bg._x = Stage.width * 0.5;
//  this.bg._y = Stage.height * 0.5;
//
// which is wrong for ultrawide resolutions as the coordinate system is 1280x720 centered,
// with negative values for x and y if wider.
//
// The fix is to replace the above with the static coordinate system center:
//
//  this.bg._x = 1280 * 0.5;
//  this.bg._y = 720 * 0.5;
//
// Other UI elements use anchors which properly take the resolution into account.
//
// ------------------------------------------------------------
// X-COM: Enemy Unknown workatound:
//
// We need to disable hash checking in PatcherGUI for allowing to install mods. But
// PatcherGUI does disable some checked, but not the one for Startup.upk, which is
// the file gfxDialogueBox.DialogueBox is in.
//
// Instead we add the patched gfxDialogueBox.DialogueBox Scaleform file to
// XComGame.upk as "XComGame.DialogueBoxFix"
// ------------------------------------------------------------


// ------------------------------------------------------------
// PHASE 1 - Add entries (don't uninstall them)
// ------------------------------------------------------------

UNINSTALL = FALSE

[ADD_NAME_ENTRY]
<%u 15> <%t "DialogueBoxFix"> <%u 0> <%u 0x00070010>

[ADD_NAME_ENTRY]
<%u 34> <%t "/ package/XComGame/DialogueBoxFix"> <%u 0> <%u 0x00070010>

[ADD_NAME_ENTRY]
<%u 14> <%t "gfxComponents"> <%u 0> <%u 0x00070010>

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Replace Camera.DoUpdateCamera
//
// Correct the camera's aspect/FOV adjustment after view-target blending and
// immediately before FillCameraCache(NewPOV).
//
// The original executable scales the FOV half-angle linearly on most maps.
// Prepare the input angle so that the original calculation produces the
// tangent-based aspect adjustment instead:
//
//     R = (ViewportWidth / ViewportHeight) * (9.0 / 16.0)
//     DesiredFOV = atan(tan(OriginalFOV * PI / 360.0) * Max(R, 1.0)) * (360.0 / PI)
//
//     Command1 / CIN_LoadScreen / CIN_HQLoadScreen:
//         PreparedFOV = DesiredFOV
//     Other maps:
//         PreparedFOV = DesiredFOV / R
//
// Use the main viewport dimensions directly. Preserve the original camera
// update, transition blending, post-process settings, and fading logic.
//
// Intended result:
//   - Hor+ above 16:9; stock tactical FOV below 16:9
//   - Vert+ below 16:9 for other cameras, including HQ/menu
//   - compensate for the native linear multiplier where it remains active
//   - 16:9 behavior remains unchanged
// ------------------------------------------------------------

UPK_FILE = Engine.upk

// Preserve initialized added locals during uninstall.
UNINSTALL = FALSE

// Class-name test avoids an Engine-to-XComGame class import.
[ADD_NAME_ENTRY]
<%u11> <%t"XComCamera"> <%u0> <%u0x00070010>

// Add local LocalPlayer UW_LocalPlayer to Camera.DoUpdateCamera.
[ADD_NAME_ENTRY]
<%u15> <%t"UW_LocalPlayer"> <%u0> <%u0x00070010>

[ADD_EXPORT_ENTRY]
<Core.ObjectProperty> <NullRef> <Camera.DoUpdateCamera> <UW_LocalPlayer> <NullRef>
<%u0> <%u0x00070004> <%u44> <%u0> <%u0> <%u0>
<%u0> <%u0> <%u0> <%u0> <%u0>

OBJECT = Camera.DoUpdateCamera.UW_LocalPlayer
REL_OFFSET = 16
[MODDED_CODE]
<%s1> <%s0> <%u0x00000000> <%u0> <None> <NullRef> <Class.LocalPlayer>

// Add local Vector2D UW_ViewportSize to Camera.DoUpdateCamera.

<%u16> <%t"UW_ViewportSize"> <%u0> <%u0x00070010>

// Remaining paths: Hor+ above 16:9; Vert+ below 16:9 for non-tactical cameras.
// F5 = FMax: use Max(R, 1.0) here, but retain actual R for native compensation.
// DesiredFOV = ATan(Tan(OriginalFOV * PI/360) * Max(R, 1.0)) * (360/PI).
// PI/360 = 0.00872664625997165; 360/PI = 114.591559026165.
// BD = Tan; BE = ATan; AB = float multiply; AC = float divide.

// PreparedFOV = DesiredFOV / R cancels that multiplication:
// native half-angle = (DesiredFOV/R) * PI/360 * R = DesiredFOV * PI/360.
// At 16:9, R=1; both paths preserve the original FOV.
// At 5:4, R=0.703125; divide by R only on maps using the native multiplier.

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Preserve facility hologram and background proportions
//
// Stock drawing scales width by screen width and height by screen height,
// stretching the materials when the screen aspect differs from 16:9.
//
//     UIWidth  = Min(SizeX, SizeY * (16.0 / 9.0))
//     UIHeight = Min(SizeY, SizeX * (9.0 / 16.0))
//     Width    = UIWidth  * NormSizeX
//     Height   = UIHeight * NormSizeY
//     X        = (SizeX - Width) * 0.5
//
//     BaseY = 20 + (SizeY - UIHeight) * 0.5
//
// Vertically center the fitted canvas on sub-16:9 screens. Draw the background
// at BaseY and vertically center the facility image relative to it. Preserve the parent HUD draw, materials, UVs and visibility.
// Fits ultrawide and sub-16:9 screens; 16:9 behavior remains unchanged.
// ------------------------------------------------------------

OBJECT = XComHQHUD.DrawHUD : AUTO
